en.t: In the afternoon, the bell for class rang.

units.source_text: 柏木依然坐着，使劲地拽住我的衣袖。

en.t: Kashiwagi remained seated and tugged hard at my sleeve.

units.source_text: 我的制服是翻修了临济学院时代穿的衣服，换上钮扣改成的，

en.t: My uniform had been remade from the clothes I had worn at Rinzai Academy, altered by changing the buttons,

units.source_text: 布料旧，且有破损，再加上衣身窄小，

en.t: the fabric was old and damaged, and on top of that the body was too narrow,

units.source_text: 我本来就单薄的身躯显得更加瘦小了。

en.t: so my already slight body looked even thinner and smaller.
